name: purchasing-po-en
query: Raise a purchase order to {vendor_name} for 10 x {purchase_item}.
expected_behavior: Resolves the vendor's CardCode (a supplier) and the ItemCode with live queries
The proposed purchase order (as shown in the receipt) has the resolved item with quantity 10
States the DocDueDate (required-by date) it intends to use, or asks for it
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
The receipt shows a unit price and line total with a currency code, or says the vendor has no price for the item and asks for one
